title: MCP Error Messages Found in README.md
body:
The claude_desktop_config.json example causes an error.
The value for "command" should be enclosed in double quotes:
Incorrect: "command": python,
Correct: "command": "python",

Tools -> Run Python Script -> Select the Plugins/GenerativeAISupport/Content/Python/mcp_client.py file.
The file "mcp_client.py" should be replaced with "unreal_socket_server.py".
author: yosanyu

comments.body: Thank you for noticing, fixed in the latest commit.
